functions.name: Equal
functions.summary: Equal compares two MACs for equality without leaking timing information.

functions.name: New
functions.summary: New returns a new HMAC hash using the given [hash.Hash] type and key. New functions like [crypto/sha256.New] can be used as h. h must return a new Hash every time it is called. Note that unlike other hash implementations in the standard library, the returned Hash does not implement [encoding.BinaryMarshaler] or [encoding.BinaryUnmarshaler].
